nf2323371de.headline: No 10 denies reports Starmer is preparing to miss 2030 clean energy target
nf2323371de.summary: Number 10 has denied reports that Prime Minister Keir Starmer is preparing to miss the 2030 clean energy target. Reports said the goal could be dropped to keep energy bills down.
nf2323371de.why: The UK clean power target shapes investment in renewables and grid infrastructure, and it affects household energy costs.

na249f2ec39.headline: Europe Plans Satellite Powerhouse To Rival Musk's Starlink
na249f2ec39.summary: Three leading European aerospace groups announced a plan to merge their satellite operations. The combined business aims to compete particularly with Elon Musk's Starlink internet system.
na249f2ec39.why: Satellite broadband is a growing market, and European consolidation aims to build scale against SpaceX's Starlink.

ncaf486fcb4.headline: Emfuleni resumes smart meter installations after month-long halt
ncaf486fcb4.summary: Emfuleni municipality has resumed smart meter installations after a halt of more than a month. The stoppage disrupted service delivery and cost the municipality revenue while it struggles with financial obligations.
ncaf486fcb4.why: Municipal revenue from metered services is critical for South African local governments with strained finances.

n5545b30d35.headline: American ranchers demand Trump abandon plan to buy Argentine beef
n5545b30d35.summary: American cattle ranchers are calling on the Trump administration to abandon plans to buy Argentine beef. The rift between the two sides is deepening, according to the report.
n5545b30d35.why: Beef import policy affects US cattle prices and the ranching sector, which competes directly with imported beef. Trade decisions on agricultural goods can shift domestic supply and margins.

n2b967fc3ea.headline: ‘T&TEC owes NGC $8 billion’
n2b967fc3ea.summary: Electricity provider T&TEC owes the National Gas Company approximately $8 billion, according to the report.
n2b967fc3ea.why: The state-owned utility buys gas for power generation, so payment arrears between utilities affect energy sector cash flows.

nbf409d9ecc.headline: QSE Index rises 0.14% at start of trading
nbf409d9ecc.summary: The Qatar Stock Exchange index rose 0.14% at the opening of Thursday's session, according to Gulf Times.
nbf409d9ecc.why: The Qatar Stock Exchange is the main equity market in Qatar, and its index tracks the performance of listed Qatari companies.

ne969cb5674.headline: INTERPOL arrests suspects linked to $562 million crypto Ponzi scheme in Nigeria
ne969cb5674.summary: A coordinated INTERPOL and AFRIPOL operation led to arrests in Nigeria, including suspects linked to a cryptocurrency Ponzi scheme. Investors across 17 countries are believed to have lost over $562 million.
ne969cb5674.why: Crypto Ponzi schemes erode investor trust and highlight fraud risks in digital asset markets.

nb93cff223f.headline: Al-Kaabi calls to oppose trade barriers, discriminatory measures that disadvantage natural gas, other energy products
nb93cff223f.summary: Qatar's Energy Minister Saad Sherida al-Kaabi called on members to oppose trade barriers and discriminatory measures that disadvantage natural gas and other energy products.
nb93cff223f.why: Qatar is one of the world's largest liquefied natural gas exporters, so trade rules affecting gas markets matter to global energy supply and pricing.

n520ac98d88.headline: Kansas sale barn reacts to president’s comments on beef prices, tariffs
n520ac98d88.summary: President Trump suggested American ranchers were doing well because of his tariffs on Brazil and urged ranchers to lower prices for US consumers, according to a local report.
n520ac98d88.why: US beef prices are shaped by cattle supply and trade policy, and tariffs on Brazilian imports can affect meat markets and cattle producers.

n1b92d46010.headline: Swedbank Profit Falls as Lower Interest Rates Continue to Bite
n1b92d46010.summary: Swedbank reported a smaller-than-expected decline in third-quarter net profit as lower interest rates continued to drag on its top line. Reuters reported the results.
n1b92d46010.why: Swedbank is a major Nordic bank, and its earnings are sensitive to interest rate levels in its home markets.

impacts.name: Swedbank
impacts.why: Net profit declined as lower interest rates reduced the bank's top-line income, though by less than expected.

n873b7f9600.headline: Senate rejects bills to pay federal workers during government shutdown
n873b7f9600.summary: The Senate rejected competing partisan bills to pay federal workers during the shutdown, as many employees are set to miss their first full paycheck at week's end.
n873b7f9600.why: Government shutdowns delay federal spending and wages, affecting economic activity and the outlook for public-sector-dependent regions.

n812d0cd846.headline: Youth who led Madagascar protests hope coup leader will continue to hear them as president
n812d0cd846.summary: A military coup in Madagascar followed weeks of youth protests over poverty, lack of opportunity and regular power and water cuts.
n812d0cd846.why: Political instability and coups raise risk premiums for investors in frontier economies and can disrupt business operations.

nf199589b7a.headline: This South African investment firm wants to build Africa’s first listed Bitcoin treasury company
nf199589b7a.summary: Altvest is raising $210 million to build the continent's first Bitcoin treasury company, designed to let investors and institutions hold bitcoin without managing it directly.
nf199589b7a.why: Bitcoin treasury companies hold bitcoin on their balance sheets, so their share prices can track bitcoin's price and their listing draws crypto exposure into traditional equity markets.

n9ed763fe8d.headline: Zimbabwe eases grain import restrictions after downgrading harvest
n9ed763fe8d.summary: Zimbabwe is allowing millers to import maize two months after announcing a ban, following an official downward revision of the 2024/2025 harvest.
n9ed763fe8d.why: Maize is a staple grain, and changes in import rules affect domestic food prices and the flour milling industry.

nb41a371f40.headline: India Inc revenue expands modestly, profitability dips over 0.50 pc in Q2: Report
nb41a371f40.summary: Corporate revenue in India rose 5-6% in the July-September quarter, while profitability fell by over 0.50 percentage points. Autos and pharmaceuticals struggled to pass on rising costs.
nb41a371f40.why: Quarterly corporate results across India provide a read on domestic demand, cost pressures and the health of listed companies.

ne92cbd1923.headline: China deepens push for tech self-reliance in five-year plan
ne92cbd1923.summary: China's new five-year plan emphasises technology self-reliance and domestic market growth to enhance economic stability and innovation.
ne92cbd1923.why: Five-year plans set Beijing's long-term industrial and economic priorities, which affect sectors from chips to consumer markets worldwide.

n5ceeb8ec3d.headline: Local equities gain N1.446trn
n5ceeb8ec3d.summary: Trading on the Nigerian Exchange gained N1.446 trillion on Wednesday, with investors continuing to accumulate positions. Trading remained upbeat across the floor.
n5ceeb8ec3d.why: The Nigerian Exchange is the main venue for Nigerian equities, and its market capitalisation tracks local investor sentiment.

n3d68b840b8.headline: Rural MPs unite against ‘damaging’ family farm tax in Budget row
n3d68b840b8.summary: Liberal Democrat MPs across the South West say a controversial tax is threatening the survival of small farms and rural communities. The row is tied to the UK Budget.
n3d68b840b8.why: The UK Budget sets tax policy, and changes to farm taxation affect agricultural businesses, land values and rural employment.

n148bcd9924.headline: Senate worried over challenges in downstream oil sector
n148bcd9924.summary: The Senate committee on downstream petroleum said in Abuja it is ready to tackle challenges facing the sector. The statement was made at a committee session.
n148bcd9924.why: The downstream sector covers refining, distribution and fuel supply. Regulatory and policy problems there affect fuel availability and prices in Nigeria.

n8a2eab7315.headline: Beyond Meat Shares Fall as Meme Rally Impacts Short Sellers
n8a2eab7315.summary: Beyond Meat shares dropped as much as 23% on Thursday after rallying over 1,300% within four days. The stock's swings have been driven by meme-stock trading and short-seller losses.
n8a2eab7315.why: Beyond Meat is a US plant-based food company, and its share price is highly volatile when trading is driven by retail speculation and short positions.

nfdb11f8c0d.headline: Reliance's oil imports from Russia to take a hit after US sanctions on Rosneft, Lukoil; PSUs to keep buying via traders | Company Business News
nfdb11f8c0d.summary: Reliance's oil imports from Russia are set to take a hit after US sanctions on Rosneft and Lukoil. Public-sector refiners are expected to keep buying through traders, according to the report.
nfdb11f8c0d.why: Reliance Industries is India's largest private refiner and a major buyer of Russian crude, so sanctions affecting supply routes affect its feedstock costs.

n2decbb4cf7.headline: More than 100,000 go on strike in NZ for better pay
n2decbb4cf7.summary: More than 100,000 workers from several New Zealand public sectors walked off the job in a dispute over pay and conditions. The industrial action spans multiple government services.
n2decbb4cf7.why: Large public-sector pay disputes can add fiscal pressure on the government budget and signal wider labour-market tension in the economy.

nadb5fec053.headline: Barclays, JP Morgan Take 20% Stake In LSEG's Post Trade Biz - Law360
nadb5fec053.summary: The London Stock Exchange Group sold a 20% stake in its Post Trade Solutions unit to 11 banks, including Barclays, J.P. Morgan and Citi, for £170 million ($227 million). The deal lets LSEG take more profit from its SwapClear business.
nadb5fec053.why: The London Stock Exchange Group operates exchanges, clearing and data services, and SwapClear is a major interest-rate swaps clearing service. Stake sales like this are a common way for exchange groups to raise capital and reshape their businesses.

impacts.name: London Stock Exchange Group
impacts.why: The group sold a 20% stake in Post Trade Solutions for £170 million, a capital event for the seller.

n929fb41d18.headline: Massive strike in New Zealand as 100,000 demand better pay and conditions
n929fb41d18.summary: More than 100,000 teachers, nurses, doctors, firefighters and support staff walked off the job in New Zealand on Thursday. They are demanding more money and resources for the public sector.
n929fb41d18.why: Public sector pay and staffing shape government spending and budget pressures. Large strikes can signal fiscal strain and influence policy and inflation expectations.

n717f61f2fc.headline: DWP to provide update on major PIP eligiblity changes
n717f61f2fc.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions said it will provide an update shortly on feedback received over the summer on the proposed review of Personal Independence Payment eligibility.
n717f61f2fc.why: Personal Independence Payment is a UK disability benefit, and changes to eligibility affect government welfare spending and public finances.

n3668974e1d.headline: China’s WTO salvo against India trade war or strategic move?
n3668974e1d.summary: China has filed a WTO complaint challenging India's Production-Linked Incentive schemes for electric vehicle components, a move highlighting the stakes of India's clean-technology ambitions.
n3668974e1d.why: The WTO settles trade disputes between member countries, and subsidy schemes like India's PLI programmes affect how foreign and domestic EV supply chains compete.

n3be7156298.headline: BILL TO REPEAL RGGI IN PENNSYLVANIA PASSES STATE SENATE
n3be7156298.summary: A bill to repeal Pennsylvania's participation in the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative passed the State Senate. The measure is Senate Bill 1068.
n3be7156298.why: RGGI is a cap-and-trade programme for power-sector carbon emissions, so withdrawing affects carbon allowance demand and electricity generators in participating states.

nfc32edc862.headline: India’s GDP to grow 6.7-6.9% in FY26: Deloitte India
nfc32edc862.summary: Deloitte India projected India's economy to grow 6.7-6.9% in the current fiscal year. The forecast cites buoyant demand and policy reforms.
nfc32edc862.why: India is one of the world's fastest-growing large economies, and GDP forecasts shape investor expectations for its equity and currency markets.

n39103a81aa.headline: Sensex gains 2,526 pts in 6 sessions, Nifty tops 25,850; will stock market rally continue? - BusinessToday
n39103a81aa.summary: The Sensex rose 130.06 points, or 0.15%, to 84,556.40 at the close. The benchmark has gained 2,526 points over six sessions, with the Nifty above 25,850.
n39103a81aa.why: The BSE Sensex tracks 30 large companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange and is a widely followed gauge of Indian equities.

n48106636c4.headline: Oil Prices Surge 5% Following New US Sanctions on Russia
n48106636c4.summary: Brent crude futures rose $3.39, or 5.4%, to $65.98 a barrel after new US sanctions targeted major Russian oil suppliers Rosneft and Lukoil. The gain extended the previous day's rise.
n48106636c4.why: Rosneft and Lukoil are two of Russia's largest oil producers, so sanctions on them can tighten global crude supply and feed into fuel and energy prices.
n48106636c4.why_moved: New US sanctions on two major Russian oil suppliers raised concern about tighter global crude supply, lifting Brent prices by 5.4% to $65.98 a barrel.

nbf1c761d53.headline: India’s GDP to grow between 6.7 6.9% in the current fiscal: Deloitte - BusinessToday
nbf1c761d53.summary: Deloitte expects India's GDP to grow between 6.7% and 6.9% in the current fiscal year, citing buoyant domestic demand, accommodative monetary policy and GST 2.0 reforms.
nbf1c761d53.why: GDP growth forecasts from advisers like Deloitte shape investor expectations for India's economy and corporate earnings.

n38b7a5dfc4.headline: Dassault Systemes Shares Fall After Revenue Guidance Cut
n38b7a5dfc4.summary: Dassault Systemes shares fell sharply after it lowered full-year revenue guidance and reported third-quarter results below analysts' expectations.
n38b7a5dfc4.why: Dassault Systèmes is a French software company that provides 3D design and simulation tools, and its guidance signals demand for engineering software.

impacts.name: Dassault Systemes
impacts.why: The company cut its revenue guidance and reported third-quarter results below expectations.

nc616307ec7.headline: India is very well positioned over the medium term, says Unilever
nc616307ec7.summary: Unilever expects trade in India to stabilise by November, despite temporary sales effects from GST changes and delayed consumer purchases.
nc616307ec7.why: Unilever is a global consumer goods group whose India business is one of its key emerging-market operations.

na257a1d47f.headline: Kuehne + Nagel Launches Cost-Cutting Program After Earnings Fall
na257a1d47f.summary: Kuehne + Nagel posted lower earnings and revenue and launched a cost-reduction program, flagging a challenging market and overcapacity. The Swiss logistics company reported on Thursday.
na257a1d47f.why: Kuehne + Nagel is a Swiss global freight forwarder and logistics company, so its results signal conditions in global shipping and freight.

n2b890c0dce.headline: Roche raises guidance even after weak dollar weighs on sales
n2b890c0dce.summary: Roche raised its full-year profit guidance, projecting a gain in adjusted earnings per share in the high single to low double digit percentage range, even though nine-month sales were hit by currency effects.
n2b890c0dce.why: Roche is a Swiss pharmaceutical and diagnostics group, and its guidance signals expected profitability to investors across its global sales base.

n12cf0f2224.headline: Lee says he trusts US 'rationality' amid final push for tariff deal
n12cf0f2224.summary: President Lee Jae Myung said he trusts the rationality of the United States as South Korea and Washington push to conclude months of tariff negotiations. The talks involve a $35 billion figure, according to the input.
n12cf0f2224.why: South Korea is a major exporter and a key US trade partner, so tariff terms affect its manufacturers and currency. Trade deals reshape export costs for companies across the economy.

n8d09e1944c.headline: Pakistan, IMF agree to cut tax target by Rs150 billion
n8d09e1944c.summary: Under a revised economic framework, Pakistan and the IMF agreed to reduce the tax collection target by Rs150 billion as growth slows and fiscal pressures mount.
n8d09e1944c.why: The IMF sets fiscal targets tied to loan tranches for Pakistan, so revised tax goals shape the country's budget and financing outlook.

n7d66e9f86f.headline: SBP reserves rise to $14.45 billion
n7d66e9f86f.summary: State Bank of Pakistan reserves rose by $14 million week on week to $14.45 billion as of October 17, 2025, while total liquid foreign reserves stood at $19.85 billion.
n7d66e9f86f.why: Foreign exchange reserves indicate Pakistan's capacity to cover imports and debt payments, which underpins the rupee and sovereign credit assessments.

n619e36746d.headline: Rupee gains 3 paisa against dollar
n619e36746d.summary: The rupee appreciated by 3 paisa against the dollar on Thursday, closing at Rs 281.02 compared with Rs 281.05 the previous day, according to interbank trading.
n619e36746d.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and the returns of foreign investors holding Pakistani assets.

ncb00f06dba.headline: Vietnam Aims to Produce More Bio-Ethanol
ncb00f06dba.summary: Vietnam is developing its alternative fuels industry as part of a roadmap toward net zero by 2050, with a focus on producing more bio-ethanol.
ncb00f06dba.why: Bio-ethanol is a biofuel blended into gasoline, and government targets for it shape demand for agricultural feedstocks and energy-transition investment.
